summary: Below 900 px fractal-web shows only the thread: the agent sidebar is no longer docked and opens as a left sheet from the header chevron, and one 'Agent details' button opens a right sheet with the agent's actions above Changes or the open tool, replacing the inline Details panel at that width. Both sheets use the new kit NarrowSheet. Wider windows are unchanged.

schema.detail: No storage changes; the persisted sidebar collapse state still applies only to the docked sidebar.

compatibility.detail: New kit exports NarrowSheet (side start|end, actions slot, scrolling body) and NarrowActionRow from @smalltalk/fractal-ui/assistant-ui/shell; ThreadHeader gains an optional `narrow` prop. ChangesInspector's `width` also accepts 'fill'. The header Agent button's accessible name changes from 'Actions for <name>' to 'Agent actions for <name>'. Below 900 px there is no docked 'Agents' complementary; the header shows 'Expand sidebar' (opens the 'Agents' dialog) and 'Agent details' (aria-haspopup=dialog, opens the 'Agent details' dialog) instead of the agent actions, terminal toggle and right-panel toggle.
